# Test fixture attribution

- `jfk.m4a`: John F. Kennedy's inaugural address, 20 January 1961, the 11-second excerpt that
  OpenAI's Whisper repository ships as `tests/jfk.flac`, re-encoded to mono AAC. A work of the
  United States government, in the public domain.
- `silence.m4a`: five seconds of generated digital silence (`ffmpeg -f lavfi -i anullsrc`).
